description: Fish Audio Drama 3 text to speech on one DGX Spark, served by vLLM-Omni 0.32.0 with its own fish_omni deploy config (the backbone and codebook tower stage, then the 44.1 kHz DAC codec stage, sharing the GPU through a private MPS daemon). It answers the OpenAI speech route, POST /v1/audio/speech, with voice "default" (without a reference the model picks the voice) and returns wav, pcm, flac, mp3 or opus. Write a dialogue inside the input with speaker tags <|speaker:0|> to <|speaker:15|> and short event tags such as [sighs] or [laughs]; 83 languages. Cloning from a reference clip is not part of this route. vLLM-Omni 0.34 cannot serve Drama 3 (its codec stage needs the retired Model Runner V1), so this recipe stays on 0.32.0. vLLM-Omni's start deadlines are raised from 300 s per stage and 600 s overall to 3600 s and 7200 s, because on a Spark the backbone stage's weights alone take about 280 s to load. Memory is an estimate until tried: the stage budgets are vLLM-Omni's deploy-config fractions verified on 1x H100 80 GB (0.78 and 0.1 of 80 GiB), converted to 0.513 and 0.066 of a Spark, and the declared 82 GB peak is those budgets plus margin; for comparison, Aevonix's GB10 recipe measured 52.5 GiB resident and a 54.1 GiB load peak on a different engine, SGLang-Omni. Fish Audio Community License: free for research and non-commercial use, commercial use below USD 500,000 annual revenue, and a separate licence for a hosted text-to-speech service.
title: Fish Audio Drama 3 (vLLM-Omni, single Spark)
